samples.summary: New todo file's checklists are all unchecked and the paired lessons file says work is 'to be filled in as it lands,' but the backend controller, CLI command, and registry entries it describes are already fully implemented in the working tree.
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260903-api-v1-folders-copy-todo.md lists every Backend/CLI/Docs item as `- [ ]` (unchecked), and 20260903-api-v1-folders-copy-lessons.md says '_To be filled in as the work lands._' Yet packages/backend/src/api/v1/folders.controller.ts, packages/backend/src/api/v1/documents.controller.ts (copy/folderId support), packages/cli/src/commands/folders.ts, and packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts (docs.copy, docs.move, folders.list/create/rename/move/delete) all already exist and match the plan's description in full. The task-tracking prose misrepresents the state of the work as not-yet-started when the code backing it appears to already be present.
